title: unforge.press.v0
description: Record returned by UNFORGE Press. Prints ids from a UNFORGE-PREUVE-v1 or UNFORGE-PREUVE-v2 card. Does not open the signature. Does not verify a file. ok: true is not a match — that is unforge-check.

ok.description: Card is UNFORGE-PREUVE-v1 or v2 and the A5 HTML was written. v1 is legacy (banner: resseller v2). Not a file-match verdict. Not a seal.

sha256.description: objet.sha256 as written on the card. Printed, not recomputed.

empreinte.description: Card fingerprint as written. Printed, not recomputed.

html.description: Path of the A5 artifact when written.

mesure.description: MESURE-v0 satellite after consulter (kit presse / porte 8). Consulting spends a reading. Copied ids, not recomputed. Not a seal. Not a receipt. Rail: https://github.com/carllaliberte/mesure-protocol

consomme.description: This print spent one reading. Not written onto the MESURE card.

ancrage.description: ANCRAGE-v0 satellite after verifier (re-press / portes 3+7). Read-only. Expired avant = re-measure, not fake. Press does not write a new date. Not a seal. Not a receipt. Rail: https://github.com/carllaliberte/ancrage-protocol

verifie.description: This print verified the date. Not written onto the ANCRAGE card.
